column3: BSB renders “for a testimony against you will be” as “will testify against you.”
BSB renders “not does he resist you” as “who did not resist you.”
BSB renders “the early and latter” as “the fall and spring rains.”
BSB renders “being made effective” as “great power to prevail.”
BSB renders “three years and six months” as “three and a half years.”
BSB follows the critical text with “his soul.”
